tokens.accent: one accent color only; never a purple/violet gradient as the default
tokens.neutral_ramp: a single neutral ramp (e.g. slate 50..900) for surfaces and text
tokens.spacing: a 4/8px modular grid; never hand-pick arbitrary margins
tokens.type_scale: ~1.25 ratio, cap ~4 sizes in normal use; 1-2 font families
tokens.radius: small/medium radii only; no heavy soft drop-shadows on everything
tokens.contrast: meet WCAG AA (4.5:1 body, 3:1 large text/UI boundaries)

rules: Establish a clear visual hierarchy: exactly one primary action per view.
Restrained palette: 1 accent + a neutral ramp; never encode meaning by color alone.
Visible focus rings on every interactive element; full keyboard operability.
Reject the AI-slop tells: purple gradients, oversized shadowed cards, the generic centered-hero + three-feature-cards layout, emoji-as-icons, dead-end navigation.
A 'decent MVP' passes the ui-ux-foundations rubric, not pixel-perfection.
